backend/main.mo: Motoko backend handling user profiles with authorization checks and public contact inquiry creation, plus admin‑restricted inquiry retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing features, associated files, components, test IDs, and confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-style text that provides short summaries for various frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and custom CSS variables defining color themes, radii, and dark mode values.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting metadata and linking favicon and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with hash-based routing between home and admin views and shared layout components.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen shown when a user lacks admin access, offering login and navigation home.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Button handling Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and React Query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: About section describing company background and feature highlights using cards and icons.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Contact form with validation, inquiry submission, and a contact info card showing phone number 7019071669.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Renders the homepage hero section with headline, CTAs, stats, and smooth scroll to contact.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Displays a grid of service cards with icons, descriptions, and a button linking to the contact section.
frontend/src/components/site/Footer.tsx: Defines the footer with company info, navigation links, social icons, and a CTA button.
frontend/src/components/site/Header.tsx: Implements a responsive header with logo, navigation links, mobile menu, and smooth scrolling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context, handling login, logout, stored identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides hooks to create and fetch inquiries using the backend actor and includes message parsing helpers.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles, color variables, dark mode settings, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Implements the admin dashboard with identity checks, admin validation, and filtered inquiry listing.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage fallback.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, breakpoints, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata including features, issues, branding notes, and build-state information.
